name: Kineticist Overwhelming Soul — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Kineticist Overwhelming Soul from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Overwhelming Soul" but are not part of the Kineticist Overwhelming Soul entry, which is unchanged.

This replaces elemental overflow.

Overwhelming souls may learn the following unique wild talent:

Overwhelming Skill

Element(s): universal; Type utility (Su); Level 3; Burn —

Prerequisite(s) greater skilled kineticist, overwhelming power class feature

The benefits of skilled kineticist apply to all of your kineticist class skills, and you do not need ranks in these skills to make skill checks with them. At 12th level this instead applies to all skills.

Overwhelming souls may learn the following unique feats:

Overwhelming Defense

Prerequisite(s): Overwhelming soul 3rd.

Benefit(s): You are treated as though you have accepted 1 burn when determining the effect of your elemental defense. At 6th level, and every 3 levels thereafter, you are treated as having accepted an additional burn in your elemental defense. If you have more than 1 elemental defense, you can split this effective burn between them in whatever way you wish.

Special: This feat cannot allow you to be treated as accepting more burn than would normally be allowed by an elemental defense.
